verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Mailgun serves a working llms.txt at documentation.mailgun.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) listing a map of documentation files, and the docs also include agent-oriented MCP documentation explicitly designed for AI assistants to consume conversationally. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents actually using llms.txt in practice, and no evidence of per-page .md agent-friendly formatting beyond the index.
